question: Are both endpoints of the v1 cumulative NASDAQ/VIX return internally supported on every 2019-2020 holiday_reopen row that supplies the observed C1 gain?
fixed_subset: existing holiday_reopen == 1 on consumed 2019-2020 holdout; no threshold or row selection search

endpoint_contract.target_endpoint_supported: the target China row's panel us_nasdaq and us_vix_chg exactly match percentage changes reconstructed from the packaged series on their last available source sessions strictly before the target China day
endpoint_contract.start_endpoint_supported: the immediately previous China row also passes the same exact alignment check, proving no more recent US source session required by the already-materialized panel feature is absent before the previous China boundary
endpoint_contract.v1_start_date: last joint nonmissing packaged US date strictly before previous China day
endpoint_contract.v1_end_date: last joint nonmissing packaged US date strictly before target China day
endpoint_contract.date_consistency: v1 start/end dates must equal the last joint nonmissing packaged US dates at their respective boundaries
endpoint_contract.why_intermediate_missing_dates_do_not_br: a compounded endpoint return level_end/level_start-1 does not require intermediate levels once the correct causal endpoints are proven

report: per-row target day, previous China day, start/end US dates, cumulative NASDAQ/VIX and gap
interpretation_rule: Only if all holiday rows pass both endpoint and date-consistency checks may the holiday accumulated-return measurement be called internally supported. Passing does not promote a holiday routing rule because the localization was discovered on a consumed holdout and has only 12 observations.
